subject: PrivDeploy quote — consolidation of fees and support ladder
messages:
From: James Porter <procurement@helixcare.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Anita Chen <legal@helixcare.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify HelixCare PrivDeploy quote (platform fee vs per-site)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the proposal — attached is our RFI and the current draft quote (we pulled together on our side). Two items stood out where we need clearer economics before we advance to procurement/legal:

1) Platform fee amortization: your quote shows a single up-front platform fee of $450k plus per-node credits. Can you provide a comparable scenario where the platform fee is amortized monthly over 36 months (so we can compare cashflow & capex treatment)?

2) Support ladder: HelixCare runs 3 production sites with varying SLAs. We need a clear mapping: what support tiers map to response/restore SLAs and what discounts, if any, apply when we commit to a 24–36 month term?

Also, Anita on our legal team asked whether an escrow or limited-scope warranty reduces the platform fee by any standard percentage in previous deals.

Attached: HelixCare_RFI_20260815.pdf

Can we get a short consolidated table and a recommended commercial approach by EOD Tuesday? We need it for our internal finance review.

Best,
James
Procurement Manager — HelixCare

On Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 08:05 AM HelixCare Account Team wrote: > Draft SOW and runbook attached for context.

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: James Porter <procurement@helixcare.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-16T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify HelixCare PrivDeploy quote (platform fee vs per-site)

James — thanks for the clear asks and the RFI. Looping in Marissa (commercial) and Irene (legal/ops) so we can put together a consolidated view.

High-level notes:
- We can present the same economics two ways: (A) one-time platform fee + node credits; (B) amortized platform fee over a term with a smaller monthly charge and reduced up-front. Both arrive at equivalent NPV with different cashflow.
- Support ladder: we have three published tiers (Standard, Premier, SRE Retainer). Each tier has defined response/restore windows; volume commitments change price per node and can trigger 5–15% discount bands.
- Escrow/warranty: we typically allow a limited-scope escrow for critical on-prem models; historically this has driven a 5% concession on platform fee in a handful of deals, but it depends on audit complexity.

Action items for internal: Marissa to run two commercial scenarios (36m amortization and 12m upfront) + discount ladders by commit band. Irene to confirm legal precedent on escrow concessions and propose language we can offer without legal exposure. Rafael to package into a single comparative table for HelixCare.

I will aim to send the consolidated table and recommendation by Tuesday (2026-08-18) morning PT. If HelixCare needs it sooner, tell me and we’ll prioritize.

— Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-18T07:46:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft pricing scenarios + notes (internal)

FYI — I pulled the two scenarios into the attached workbook (RI_Quote_HelixCare_20260818.xlsx). Key points and options I recommend we share with HelixCare:

• Scenario A (Upfront platform fee):
  - Platform fee: $450,000 one-time
  - Node credits: $120k/year equivalent (for 3 sites)
  - Support (Premier): $90k/year
  - Total year-1 cashflow: $660k
  - Upside: lower ongoing ops accounting overhead; better for short pilots

• Scenario B (36-month amortized):
  - Platform fee amortized: $13,000/month (36 mo) = ~$468k NPV at 8%
  - Node fee billed monthly: $10k/month
  - Support (Premier) included as monthly $7k
  - Year-1 cashflow: ~$360k (lower up-front)
  - Upside: smoother capex-to-opex profile; easier for customers with limited upfront budgets

• Discount ladder recommendations (applied to total recurring fees):
  - 12–24 month commit: 5% recurring discount
  - 24–36 month commit: 10% recurring discount + 2% platform fee concession
  - >=36 month+ multi-account anchor: 15% recurring discount + up to 5% platform concession (requires exec approval)

• Escrow / warranty: recommend offering a limited-scope escrow for the model artifacts with a 3–5% platform fee concession; anything beyond that (full IP escrow) should be referred to legal & requires a one-time engineering validation fee.

Notes for Rafael: I added a redline column in the workbook called "Commercial Recommendation" with our suggested default (Scenario B + 24–36 mo commit => 10% recurring discount + 2% platform concession). If HelixCare pushes for more platform fee reduction we should trade for an increased commit term or a higher operational retainer.

Attachment: RI_Quote_HelixCare_20260818.xlsx (internal pricing workbook)

-Marissa
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Date: 2026-08-20T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: HelixCare — consolidated commercial proposal and next steps

James / Anita — thank you for the patience. Attached is a short consolidated table and our recommended path. To summarize the options:

Option 1 — Pilot / Short-term (12 months)
- One-time platform fee: $450k
- Node credits: billed monthly; estimate $120k/year
- Support (Premier): billed annually; $90k/year
- Typical concessions: up to 5% on recurring fees with 12–24 month commit

Option 2 — Smoother Opex (recommended)
- Platform fee amortized over 36 months: ~$13k/month (we show equivalent NPV in the attachment)
- Node credits and support included in monthly billing; net recurring discount 10% for 24–36 month commit
- Platform fee concession: 2% if they sign 24–36 months; up to 5% requires exec sign-off and an anchor across >=2 accounts
- Escrow: limited-scope escrow possible; standard concession 3% platform fee (legal to confirm exact language)

Requested next steps (mutual action):
1) Confirm which option HelixCare prefers (Option 1 vs Option 2) by 2026-08-25.
2) If Option 2, share desired commit length (24 vs 36 months) and whether you want the limited-scope escrow addendum.
3) We will circulate a clean quote and a conditional term sheet for HelixCare legal to review within 48 hours of selection.

If helpful I can set a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the workbook and run two custom cashflow views for your finance team.

Best regards,
Rafael Mendes
